annotations.title: Spiegel mit & ohne Rahmen finden Sie bei Höffner online

content.text:
If you mean the **old Spiegel catalog** for home/fashion mail-order shopping: Spiegel was a major U.S. catalog retailer, but it no longer appears to operate as a current online catalog store for home goods in the same way it once did. Historical references describe Spiegel as selling apparel, home furnishings, housewares, and other goods through its catalog. ([encyclopedia.com](https://www.encyclopedia.com/economics/economics-magazines/spiegel-group?utm_source=openai))

If you’re trying to shop **home items online now**, here are alternatives:

- **Wayfair** – furniture, décor, bedding, lighting
- **Amazon Home** – broad home-goods selection
- **Home Depot / Lowe’s** – home improvement + décor
- **Target / Walmart** – affordable home basics
- **Pottery Barn / West Elm / Crate & Barrel** – higher-end furniture and décor
- **IKEA** – budget furniture and storage

If by **“spiegel”** you meant the German word **Spiegel = mirror**, then online mirror-shopping results include retailers like home24, Westwing, Höffner, and other European furniture shops. ([hoeffner.de](https://www.hoeffner.de/garderoben-spiegel?utm_source=openai))
